symptoms: PPS (Painful Progressive Swelling / Cytotoxic - Puff adder, Spitting cobra): Severe pain, swelling >15cm/h.
PW (Progressive Weakening / Neurotoxic - Black mamba, Cobras): Metallic taste, sweating, salivation, ptosis, dyspnoea, paralysis.
B (Bleeding / Haemotoxic - Boomslang, Vine snake): Uncontrolled bleeding, abnormal 20min clotting test.

management_steps.details: IV line in non-bitten limb. Analgesia: Paracetamol, Codeine, Morphine. Elevate limb (PPS). Protect airway (PW).

Dilute antivenom 50/50 in isotonic fluid over 15-30 min OR IV push 1 amp/min:
- Puff Adder: 50-100ml Polyvalent
- Mozambique Spitting Cobra: 100ml+ Polyvalent
- Gaboon Adder: 200ml Polyvalent
- Black Mamba / Snouted Cobra: 80-200ml Polyvalent
- Boomslang / Vine Snake: 20ml Monovalent antivenom IV.
Atropine + Neostigmine trial for cobras. If no improvement in 30 mins: give additional 4 vials antivenom.

warnings: Do NOT give Aspirin or NSAIDs (increases bleeding risk).
Do NOT give heparin or anti-fibrinolytics.
